title: Allow local HumanOps to request genuine review of its own task without impersonating agents

owned: Allow handoff in LOCAL_HUMAN_OPS_ACTIONS in scripts/ai_status.py (+1 net production line)
Preserve lease security intent: approve/done/progress stay denied at lease layer
Add own-owner positive, foreign-owner negative, and wrong-reviewer target tests in scripts/test_ai_status.py
not_changing: Canonical owner and reviewer validation in prepare_external_mutation_preflight and command_handoff
Delivery binding resolution (resolve_handoff_delivery_binding) and CAS preflight verification
Supervisor scheduling, worker leases, or dispatch policies
Product runtime, frontend, live config, or deployment truth

failure_reproduction.case: Actual failure receipt /tmp/pantheon-completion-parent-g17-original-independent-review-handoff-20261017.json: supported d0695d2c89a1fdcaac1eea56309532fda3fabf2e human-ops-status.sh handoff DEV-SIX-AREA-HOSTED-CLOSEOUT-20261002 Antigravity rejects with RuntimeError: local Human/Ops cannot authorize handoff; allowed actions are archive_collision_fence, archive_correct_review_file, archive_reconcile, artifact-contract, assign, dependency-contract, dependency-track, execution-resource, milestone, note, operator_accept, reconcile_merged_done, record_terminal_fact, reopen, resume_integration, retire_archive_collision, supersede, sync.
failure_reproduction.prior_outcome: Local Human/Ops mode was unable to initiate review handoff for a canonically owned task because validate_active_status_command_lease rejected handoff before owner and reviewer preflight checks.
failure_reproduction.regression: test_local_human_ops_handoff_validates_owner_and_reviewer_guards and test_local_human_ops_own_task_handoff_reaches_immutable_binding_and_denials prove that local Human/Ops can hand off its own task to the assigned reviewer while foreign-owner handoff, wrong-reviewer target, and lease-free execution remain rejected.

implementation.allowlist: Added 'handoff' to LOCAL_HUMAN_OPS_ACTIONS in scripts/ai_status.py (+1 net line, within 4-line budget).
implementation.guards_preserved: Existing prepare_external_mutation_preflight and command_handoff guards enforce canonical owner equality (task owner must match current actor Human/Ops), assigned reviewer equality (handoff target must match assigned reviewer), delivery binding resolution, and CAS checks.
implementation.role_boundaries: approve, done, and progress remain strictly denied for local Human/Ops; non-local mutations require an exact active worker lease; no frozen binding or status changes on denial.

review_decision.note: Verify that handoff is permitted in LOCAL_HUMAN_OPS_ACTIONS, role boundaries (approve/done/progress denial) are maintained, and own-owner positive and foreign-owner/wrong-reviewer negative checks pass.
